duga-tagline: The project tagline, shown under the name on the home page. Keep it short. In your language, feel free to choose a natural local term rather than transliterating "queer" if there's a better-established one -- see the /about page for the terminology policy.
duga-nav-home: Link label in the site navigation, goes back to the home page.
duga-nav-about: Link label in the site navigation, goes to the About page.
duga-home-title: The project name, shown as the main heading on the home page. This is a proper noun ("Duga") -- most languages should leave it untranslated, like a brand name.
duga-home-intro: One-paragraph explanation of what Duga is, shown on the home page below the title.
duga-home-pick-language: Label above the list of languages a visitor can choose to browse.
duga-home-interface-language: Label for the interface-language switcher: a dropdown of languages used to translate the site's own UI, independent of which language's content a visitor is browsing.
duga-home-interface-language-submit: Button label to submit the interface-language switcher form.
duga-lang-home-title: Page heading for a single language's overview. $1 is the autonym of that language (e.g. "Français").
duga-lang-home-placeholder: Placeholder shown on a language overview page before gap detection exists yet (milestone M0/M1). Will be replaced with real content in a later milestone.
duga-lang-home-back: Link back to the home page's language list.
duga-lang-home-stale: Warning shown when a detector's last run failed, so visitors know the gap list below may not reflect the current state of Wikimedia projects. $1 is a timestamp of the last successful run.
duga-lang-home-gap-count: Summary line showing how many gaps were found for this language. $1 is the count (a number).
duga-lang-home-view-gaps: Link label to the full gap list for this language.
duga-lang-home-no-gaps: Shown when detectors have run for this language but found zero gaps.
duga-gaps-title: Page heading for the gap list. $1 is the autonym of the language being browsed (e.g. "Français").
duga-gaps-back: Link back from the gap list to that language's overview page.
duga-gaps-empty: Shown when a gap list (possibly filtered) has no matching rows.
duga-gaps-what: Combines a project name and a gap-type description into one phrase for a gap row, e.g. "Wikipedia — no article yet". $1 is the project name (see duga-gaps-project-*), $2 is the gap-type description (see duga-gaps-type-*).
duga-gaps-project-wikipedia: The Wikipedia project name, shown in a gap row. Usually a proper noun, left untranslated.
duga-gaps-project-wikidata: The Wikidata project name, shown in a gap row. Usually a proper noun, left untranslated.
duga-gaps-type-no_article: Short description of the 'no_article' gap type: no Wikipedia article exists yet in this language.
duga-gaps-type-no_label: Short description of the 'no_label' gap type: the Wikidata item has no label yet in this language.
duga-gaps-type-no_description: Short description of the 'no_description' gap type: the Wikidata item has no description yet in this language.
duga-gaps-maturity-stable: Label for a detector whose results are considered reliable/stable.
duga-gaps-maturity-beta: Label for a detector whose results are still being validated.
duga-gaps-maturity-experimental: Label for a detector whose results are experimental and may be wrong or incomplete.
duga-gaps-why-in-scope: Explains which scope rule(s) made this topic count as in-scope, shown on each gap row. $1 is a comma-separated list of rule labels.
duga-gaps-fix-button: Button/link label on a gap row that takes the visitor to where they can actually fix the gap (e.g. the Wikidata item's sitelinks section).
duga-gaps-prev-page: Pagination link label to the previous page of gaps.
duga-gaps-next-page: Pagination link label to the next page of gaps.
duga-about-title: Page heading for the About page.
duga-about-name: Explains the meaning of the project name "Duga" on the About page. Keep "Duga" itself untranslated.
duga-about-body: One-paragraph restatement of the project's purpose, shown on the About page.
duga-about-license: States the software license on the About page.
duga-404-title: Heading shown on the not-found error page.
duga-404-body: Body text on the not-found error page, explaining a link may point to a language that isn't set up yet.
